response.sql: WITH funding_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS avg_area_to_volume_ratio FROM funding_metrics) SELECT f.fundflux, f.avg_y_vs_x_difference, f.area_to_volume_ratio, f.area_to_volume_ratio - c.avg_area_to_volume_ratio AS above_average FROM funding_metrics AS f CROSS JOIN cross_source AS c WHERE f.area_to_volume_ratio > c.avg_area_to_volume_ratio;
